role.zh: 云平台与 AI 工作流技术负责人

intro.zh: 我是一名云基础设施与平台工程技术负责人，拥有十余年的 DevOps、可靠性与运维自动化经验。从云平台、自助服务和安全交付，到共享框架、集群生命周期和 AI 工作流，我的工作重点是把复杂且重复的工作变成可复用、可验证、可维护的工程能力。
intro.en: I am a cloud infrastructure and platform engineering leader with more than a decade of experience in DevOps, reliability and operations automation. Across cloud platforms, self-service tooling, secure delivery, shared frameworks, infrastructure lifecycles and AI workflows, my focus has remained consistent: turning complex, repetitive work into reusable, verifiable and maintainable engineering capabilities.

intro.zh: 我兼具团队管理、架构设计与核心开发经验，习惯先理解业务目标、系统边界和长期维护成本，再把目标拆解为团队能够逐步交付的方案。当前在 Cisco 从事平台工程与 AI 运维工作，连接领域知识、执行工具和验证证据，让自动化能力真正进入日常工程流程。
intro.en: My work combines team leadership, architecture and core development. I start with the business objective, system boundaries and long-term maintenance costs, then turn the goal into work a team can deliver incrementally. At Cisco, I currently work on platform engineering and AI operations, connecting domain knowledge, execution tools and validation evidence within everyday engineering workflows.

intro.zh: 2021 年，我已在个人职业规划中提出从基础设施即代码、流水线和流程自动化走向 AI 智能工作流的方向。此后的共享库、配置驱动执行和平台控制能力，构成了今天开展 AI 工作流工程的基础。这个网站记录这条持续演进的主线，也展示我在工作之外制作的工具与游戏插件。
intro.en: In 2021, I articulated a direction from Infrastructure as Code, pipelines and process automation toward intelligent workflows based on AI. The shared libraries, configuration-driven execution and platform controls developed since then form the foundation for my current AI workflow work. This site documents that continuing thread alongside the tools and game addons I build outside work.

summary.zh: 平台工程、基础设施生命周期与 AI 工作流。
summary.en: Platform engineering, infrastructure lifecycles and AI workflows.

points.zh: 主导集群生命周期方案设计与核心开发，以声明式配置和 GitOps 工作流组织创建、升级、扩容与退役。
points.en: Lead solution design and core development for cluster lifecycle management, organizing provisioning, upgrades, expansion and retirement through declarative configuration and GitOps workflows.

points.zh: 设计共享更新框架，统一前置检查、执行阶段、健康验证与失败恢复，并兼顾有状态服务的角色和复制要求。
points.en: Design shared update frameworks that connect preflight checks, execution stages, health validation and failure recovery while accommodating roles and replication in stateful services.

points.zh: 建设分布式服务检查与 DNS 诊断能力，将检查逻辑、执行方式和目标发现解耦，为变更验证与故障分析提供依据。
points.en: Develop distributed service checks and DNS diagnostics, separating check logic, execution and target discovery to support change validation and incident analysis.

points.zh: 把领域知识、前置条件和验证方法整理成可复用的 AI Skills，连接计划、工具执行、结果核查与记录。
points.en: Turn domain knowledge, prerequisites and verification methods into reusable AI skills that connect planning, tool execution, result checking and records.

summary.zh: 平台自动化、测试框架与共享工程能力。
summary.en: Platform automation, testing frameworks and shared engineering capabilities.

points.zh: 带领平台自动化团队，主导基于 Python 的测试框架设计与开发。
points.en: Led the platform automation team and the design and development of Python-based testing frameworks.

points.zh: 通过配置模型、插件接口、执行上下文与统一结果，将场景逻辑和执行机制分离。
points.en: Separated scenario logic from execution through configuration models, plugin interfaces, execution context and common result structures.

points.zh: 推动共享 SDK、公共库、统一执行入口和开发规范，让不同项目能够复用已有工程积累。
points.en: Advanced shared SDKs, libraries, common execution entry points and development conventions so projects could reuse existing engineering work.

summary.zh: 系统安全、多云基础制品与持续交付。
summary.en: System security, multi-cloud foundation artifacts and continuous delivery.

points.zh: 带领团队建设操作系统镜像和中间件的自动化构建与发布流程，覆盖多种 Linux 发行版及公有云、私有云环境。
points.en: Led automated build and release work for operating system images and middleware across Linux distributions and public and private cloud environments.

points.zh: 将安全基线、加固与验证要求纳入标准构建流程，使安全维护成为可重复执行的工程工作。
points.en: Integrated security baselines, hardening and validation into standard build processes, making security maintenance repeatable engineering work.

points.zh: 组织上游补丁收集、数据整理、增量更新与基础镜像发布，持续沉淀共享库和自动化流程。
points.en: Organized upstream patch collection, data normalization, incremental updates and base-image releases while developing shared libraries and automation workflows.

summary.zh: 部署平台、基础设施自动化与可靠性交付。
summary.en: Deployment platforms, infrastructure automation and reliable delivery.

points.zh: 主导部署平台 CLI/API 与 Kubernetes 基础设施即代码建设，为环境交付提供一致入口。
points.en: Led deployment platform CLI/API and Kubernetes Infrastructure as Code work, providing a consistent entry point for environment delivery.

points.zh: 建设 GitLab CI 流水线，贯通构建、扫描、自动测试、打包与发布。
points.en: Developed GitLab CI pipelines connecting builds, scanning, automated tests, packaging and releases.

points.zh: 组织监控告警、on-call 与 Runbook，连接平台建设和日常运营。
points.en: Organized monitoring, alerting, on-call and runbook practices to connect platform engineering with daily operations.

summary.zh: 监控日志、容器交付与 DevOps 流程。
summary.en: Monitoring, logging, container delivery and DevOps processes.

points.zh: 建设集中监控与日志体系，连接虚拟机、容器、Kubernetes 和应用层的观察数据。
points.en: Built centralized monitoring and logging across virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes and applications.

points.zh: 落地 Kubernetes/Helm 交付流水线，并参与本地和公有云集群维护。
points.en: Implemented Kubernetes/Helm delivery pipelines and maintained on-premises and public cloud clusters.

points.zh: 推动流程规范和运维工具建设，减少依赖个人经验的重复操作。
points.en: Improved operational processes and tooling to reduce repetitive work dependent on individual knowledge.

summary.zh: 云平台、自助服务与基础设施工程。
summary.en: Cloud platforms, self-service delivery and infrastructure engineering.

points.zh: 参与 AWS IaaS/PaaS、自助化服务和运维门户建设，把云资源与服务交付转化为可编程能力。
points.en: Worked on AWS IaaS/PaaS, self-service delivery and operations portals, turning cloud resource and service delivery into programmable capabilities.

points.zh: 围绕 DynamoDB 查询、Lambda 冷启动、镜像构建和服务初始化开展性能与交付优化。
points.en: Improved performance and delivery across DynamoDB queries, Lambda cold starts, image builds and service initialization.

points.zh: 积累云 API、监控自动化、ITIL 流程和容器工具实践，为后续平台工程工作打下基础。
points.en: Built experience with cloud APIs, monitoring automation, ITIL processes and container tooling that informed later platform engineering work.

institution.en: Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology

title.zh: 从云基础设施，到 AI 工程工作流
title.en: From cloud infrastructure to AI engineering workflows

intro.zh: 我的工程经历从云基础设施与 DevOps 起步，逐步扩展到安全交付、共享框架、平台控制与 AI 工作流。贯穿这些阶段的是同一种方法：明确接口与配置，把执行、验证和知识积累组织成可以持续复用的能力。展开下方主题，可以继续阅读相关方法与个人项目。
intro.en: My engineering work has grown from cloud infrastructure and DevOps into secure delivery, shared frameworks, platform controls, and AI workflows. A consistent approach connects these stages: define interfaces and configuration, then bring execution, validation, and knowledge into reusable capabilities. Expand a topic below to explore the methods and related personal projects.

summary.zh: 从云服务、自助平台、CI/CD 到 Kubernetes，把基础设施变得可编程。
summary.en: From cloud services and self-service platforms to CI/CD and Kubernetes: making infrastructure programmable.

points.zh: 围绕重复的资源交付和应用发布工作，建设 CLI、API 与基础设施即代码。
points.en: Built CLI, API and Infrastructure as Code capabilities around repeated resource delivery and application release tasks.

points.zh: 让构建、扫描、测试和发布成为连续流程，并以监控、轮值和 Runbook 承接运行工作。
points.en: Connected builds, scanning, testing and releases while supporting operations with monitoring, on-call and runbooks.

title.zh: 安全交付与自动化底座

summary.zh: 把镜像、中间件、安全加固与补丁维护，组织成统一的构建和发布能力。
summary.en: Organized images, middleware, hardening and patch maintenance into shared build and release capabilities.

points.zh: 将安全与交付要求写进流程，使不同环境采用共同的工程方法。
points.en: Encoded security and delivery requirements in processes, using common engineering methods across environments.

points.zh: 2021 年明确提出从 IaC、Pipeline、ITIL、RPA 向 AI 智能工作流演进的方向。
points.en: Articulated a direction from IaC, pipelines, ITIL and RPA toward AI intelligent workflows in 2021.

summary.zh: 把具体场景与执行机制分离，让框架、SDK 和公共能力能够跨项目复用。
summary.en: Separated scenario logic from execution so frameworks, SDKs and shared capabilities could be reused across projects.

points.zh: 以配置模型、插件契约、执行上下文和统一结果组织测试与自动化。
points.en: Organized testing and automation through configuration models, plugin contracts, execution context and common results.

points.zh: 持续维护共享库与开发规范，让工程积累跨团队和任职阶段延续。
points.en: Maintained shared libraries and development conventions so engineering work could carry across teams and roles.

title.zh: 平台控制与 AI 工作流

summary.zh: 将生命周期管理、更新编排、分布式检查与可复用知识连接起来。
summary.en: Connected lifecycle management, update orchestration, distributed checks and reusable knowledge.

points.zh: 用声明式目标、评审和工作流管理基础设施变更，并以健康检查和恢复机制约束执行。
points.en: Managed infrastructure changes through declarative intent, review and workflows, with health checks and recovery governing execution.

points.zh: 把领域知识与验证要求工程化，形成能够调用工具、检查结果并留下记录的 AI 工作流。
points.en: Engineered domain knowledge and verification requirements into AI workflows that call tools, check results and preserve records.

summary.zh: 云 API、自助平台、CLI、Kubernetes 与交付流水线，为后续平台控制提供基础。
summary.en: Cloud APIs, self-service platforms, CLIs, Kubernetes and delivery pipelines provide a foundation for later platform controls.

summary.zh: 将构建、加固、验证、上游补丁和制品发布组织为可持续维护的流程。
summary.en: Bring builds, hardening, validation, upstream patches and artifact releases into maintainable processes.

summary.zh: 通过配置、插件接口、执行上下文和统一结果，分离业务场景与通用执行能力。
summary.en: Separate scenarios from shared execution through configuration, plugin interfaces, execution context and common results.

summary.zh: 以声明式配置、GitOps 审查与工作流，统一创建、升级、扩容和退役。
summary.en: Unify provisioning, upgrades, expansion and retirement through declarative configuration, GitOps review and workflows.

summary.zh: 通过共享阶段执行器连接前置检查、更新、健康验证和失败恢复，并适配有状态服务。
summary.en: Connect preflight checks, updates, health validation and failure recovery through shared stage execution, with support for stateful services.

summary.zh: 将检查、目标发现、执行与结果汇总解耦，把验证前移到变更流程。
summary.en: Separate checks, target discovery, execution and result aggregation, bringing validation earlier in change workflows.

summary.zh: 连接计划、变更记录、工具执行、结果核查和回写，将多步运维工作组织成完整流程。
summary.en: Connect planning, change records, tool execution, result checks and updates within complete multi-step operational workflows.

title.zh: 可复用领域知识与 Skills

summary.zh: 把领域经验、前置条件和验证要求转成可发现、可审查、可安装和可维护的知识模块。
summary.en: Turn domain experience, prerequisites and validation requirements into discoverable, reviewable, installable and maintainable knowledge modules.

summary.zh: 固定审查版本，连接声明式配置、工作流产物与服务检查，并让排障案例反哺知识库和开发修复。
summary.en: Pin review revisions, connect declarative configuration, workflow artifacts and service checks, and use diagnosis cases to improve shared knowledge and development fixes.

summary.zh: 先理解真实需求和约束，再寻找跨场景的共性，用接口、配置和框架承接重复工作。
summary.en: Start with real needs and constraints, identify shared patterns across scenarios, and use interfaces, configuration and frameworks to handle recurring work.

summary.zh: 既关注系统边界与长期演进，也深入关键实现，推动方案从设计走到可维护的工程结果。
summary.en: Work on system boundaries and long-term evolution while staying involved in critical implementation and maintainable delivery.

summary.zh: 通过工程规范、共享库、设计文档和知识分享组织团队能力，减少工具和经验孤岛。
summary.en: Build team capabilities through engineering conventions, shared libraries, design documentation and knowledge sharing.

summary.zh: 将前置条件、健康检查、结果证据和恢复机制纳入自动化设计，让每次执行能够被理解和复盘。
summary.en: Include prerequisites, health checks, result evidence and recovery in automation design so executions can be understood and reviewed.

about.zh: 工作之外，我也把工具制作当作一种表达方式：为自己的实际需求写 Python 工具，探索 MCP 与服务集成，也为《魔兽世界》制作界面、组队和战斗辅助插件。它们和我的工作有一个共同点——从具体体验出发，把需要反复处理的事做好。
about.en: Outside work, I also build tools as a form of expression: Python utilities for practical needs, MCP and service integrations, and World of Warcraft addons for interfaces, group coordination and encounter assistance. They share a starting point with my engineering work: a concrete experience and a recurring task worth improving.

about.zh: 我偏理性、自驱，喜欢追问一个方案为什么有效、边界在哪里，以及未来如何维护。比起堆叠更多工具，我更关注已有能力能否被清晰组织、持续复用，并让一起工作的人更容易交付。
about.en: I am analytical and self-driven. I like to understand why an approach works, where its boundaries lie and how it will be maintained. I care about organizing existing capabilities clearly, reusing them over time and making delivery easier for the people I work with.
